items.question: M Who's receiving the shipment of construction materials today? w
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“M Who's receiving the shipment of construction materials today? w”，自然应答是“Please check with Ms. Choi.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（Please check with Ms. Choi.）。
